newsitem.title: USA: Ford axle plant resumes output after fire.
newsitem.headline: Ford axle plant resumes output after fire.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said a fire Wednesday halted production at an axle plant here for nearly two hours, causing minimal damage before operations were resumed.
The fire started in some plastic shipping materials in an outdoor loading dock area at about 1430 EDT/1830 GMT, forcing the evacuation of about 1,200 employees, said Ford spokeswoman Denise Bither.

The plant, which produces front axles, rear axles and drive shafts, resumed operations at about 1610 EDT/2010 GMT, Bither said. She did not have an estimate of lost production, but said the only damage sustained was to loading dock doors.
The plant operates on three shifts per day.
